literature.role: Known constant-degree diagonal-equation support construction, not a full-depth solver.

research_decision: Cheap nonlinear cycle evaluation and acceptance1 already exist at one root step. Target full-depth polynomial original supply with a prefix-informed action or a costed noncommuting receiver. Reusing lower-prefix-only triples and filtering for an extra modulus J loses the exact factor J^(-2n); implicit direction count alone does not repair that.

proof_obligations.PO-MASK: Use n+1 disjoint nonempty masks cancelling actual B curvature. The known automatic finder uses M=(n+1)^3 and reads only first-digit rows; provided masks on selected sources are not an IID guarantee.
proof_obligations.PO-INVARIANT: Prove every tangent column and deterministic kernel choice is unchanged along the chosen line. A pointwise equal-pair search or changing kernel choice does not imply a global tau^3 identity.
proof_obligations.PO-CLEAN: Compile the explicit polynomial word algorithm coherently with comparisons and Gaussian scratch uncomputed. Canonicalize three words and erase the original index. Hardware synthesis and aggregate error certificates remain unimplemented.
proof_obligations.PO-SOURCE: Original IID full frequency pairs from the even-native integer-secret model; a low-only policy leaves conditional high lifts independent. Fresh batches are needed for independent children.
proof_obligations.PO-MENU: A word-dependent polynomial program is not a polynomial explicit direction list. Under full-rank mask premises it realizes at least3^n directions; no assertion that all random guaranteed masks have full rank.
proof_obligations.PO-LIFT: For an unchanged H0-only triple partition, retaining H0*J-prefix-constant triples has mean extra survival J^(-2n), conditional on each low matrix and accepted tag. Charge this factor before normalizing the residual native child.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: The lift gate does not exclude policies informed by the larger prefix, sequential fresh root-lowering, known secret-digit correction, noncommuting receivers, coherent orbit interference or source-state-specific approximations.
proof_obligations.PO-DEPTH: The shallow construction is the existing sieve with pointers kept coherent. It does not remove recursive full-depth source fan-in or prove a new polynomial solver.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: External mathematical review and novelty checks are pending. No generic lower bound, original-state dequantization, accepted new algorithm or LWE attack is claimed.

falsifiers: A selected mask has nonzero curvature or overlaps another mask.
Tangent records or kernel choice change along an alleged three-cycle.
An actual original native prefix, phase or canonical erasure identity fails.
Conditional high lifts do not enumerate every child frequency pair or yield the exact unseen-prefix factor.
A selected label instance or shallow perfect-acceptance control is promoted to a full-depth population speedup.
